content.name: Katharina Vogel
content.title: Lead Cyber Defence Analyst
content.summary: Lead cyber defence analyst with 15 years in Frankfurt across a data centre operator, a private bank and an energy network operator classed as critical infrastructure (KRITIS). Leads a six-person blue team and coordinated the company's BSI-facing incident reporting. Strong in detection engineering, OT security and regulatory evidence under BAIT, DORA and the IT-Sicherheitsgesetz.

experience.title: IT Security Analyst
bullets: Monitored IDS and firewall logs for a colocation data centre hosting 150 business customers.
Built a vulnerability scanning routine for customer-facing management systems and tracked 900+ findings through remediation.
Supported ISO/IEC 27001 certification on the basis of IT-Grundschutz, writing 30 operating procedures.

experience.title: Senior Security Analyst
bullets: Ran the bank's SIEM use-case catalogue, growing it from 20 to 110 detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
Prepared security evidence for BaFin audits against BAIT, with no major findings in two consecutive reviews.
Coordinated the yearly external penetration test and drove remediation of 95% of findings within agreed deadlines.
Trained 400 employees a year on social engineering, with phishing simulation click rates falling from 14% to 4%.

experience.title: Lead Cyber Defence Analyst
bullets: Lead a six-person blue team covering IT and OT networks for an electricity and gas distribution operator.
Introduced attack detection systems for the control network, as required for KRITIS operators, and passed the first external evidence audit with minor observations only.
Coordinated the reporting chain to the BSI for significant incidents and ran four crisis exercises with management.
Built a threat-hunting practice that found and removed two long-dormant footholds in legacy systems.
Manage a €1.4 million annual security operations budget, including a co-managed SOC contract.

achievements.title: Speaker, German critical infrastructure security forum
achievements.detail: Presented lessons from deploying attack detection in an energy control network.

achievements.title: Member, Allianz für Cyber-Sicherheit working group
achievements.detail: Contribute to an energy-sector exchange on detection use cases.
